description: This file is a C source file for a diagnostic module in an AUTOSAR-based automotive software platform. It contains code for managing diagnostic event status, freeze frame data, extended data, and NVM interactions, following regulatory and standards compliance (e.g., MISRA, GPL). It includes function implementations for handling event status, DTC filters, freeze frame storage, checksum calculations, and external memory interactions.

classes.name: DtcFilterType
classes.description: Structure defining filter parameters for DTC selection based on status, kind, origin, severity, and fault detection counter.

classes.name: DisableDtcStorageType
classes.description: Structure for controlling DTC storage enable/disable status by group and kind.

classes.name: EventStatusRecType
classes.description: Structure holding runtime status of a diagnostic event, including counters, status bits, and occurrence count.

classes.name: EventRecType
classes.description: Structure for storing event occurrence, status, and checksum in primary event memory.

classes.name: ExtDataRecType
classes.description: Structure for storing extended data associated with an event, including event ID, data buffer, and checksum.

classes.name: Dem_StateType
classes.description: Enumeration representing the current initialization state of the Dem module.
